blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Five words appear in almost every tax conversation. A taxpayer is anyone who pays tax. It can be a person or a company. Revenue is the money that the government collects from taxes.

The tax rate is the percentage that is applied to calculate the tax. An exemption is a rule that says something is not taxed. A deduction is an amount that you can subtract before the tax is calculated.

Learning these five words makes the whole subject much less frightening. Everything else is built on them.

items.q: Who is a taxpayer?
items.why: "A taxpayer is anyone who pays tax." Pode ser pessoa ou empresa.

items.q: What is revenue in this text?
options: The money the government collects from taxes
items.why: "Revenue is the money that the government collects from taxes."

items.q: What is a deduction?
options: An amount you subtract before the tax is calculated
items.why: "A deduction is an amount that you can subtract before the tax is calculated."

items.q: The text says "everything else is built on them." This suggests that…
options: these five words are the base for the rest of the subject
tax is very easy for everyone
there are only five words in tax
items.why: Inferência: se tudo é construído sobre essas palavras, elas são a base — mas há mais coisa depois.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: the tax rate is not important
learning the basic words first makes tax easier to understand
a taxpayer is always a company
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que aprender essas palavras deixa o assunto "less frightening".

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry ajudando a nova assistente. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, let's go over the five words for your call tomorrow. Take your time. There is no rush.

First, "contribuinte" in English is taxpayer. A taxpayer is a person or a company that pays tax. Very simple. Next, "receita" is revenue. Revenue is the money that the government gets from taxes.

Now, "alíquota" is the tax rate. The tax rate is a percentage. You apply it to calculate the tax. For example, ten percent.

Then we have "isenção", which is exemption. An exemption means that something is not taxed. And the last one, "dedução", is deduction. A deduction is an amount that you subtract before you calculate the tax.

So, five words: taxpayer, revenue, tax rate, exemption, deduction. Write them down. If you learn these five, you will understand almost every tax conversation. You are ready. Good luck tomorrow.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Why is Harry going over the five words with the assistant?
options: For a report to the boss
items.why: "let's go over the five words for your call tomorrow."

items.q: What is the English word for "alíquota"?
items.why: "'alíquota' is the tax rate."

items.q: What does an exemption mean?
items.why: "An exemption means that something is not taxed."

items.q: When Harry says "Take your time. There is no rush," he wants the assistant to feel…
items.why: Inferência: ele fala com calma para deixá-la tranquila antes da ligação.

items.q: Why does Harry say "You are ready" at the end?
options: He thinks she now knows enough for the call
She has finished all her work for the year
items.why: Inferência: depois de repassar as cinco palavras, ele mostra confiança de que ela está preparada.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Every taxpayer must send the form by April." A taxpayer is…
options: a person or company that pays tax
items.why: Taxpayer = contribuinte: quem paga o imposto.

items.q: "The tax rate is ten percent this year." The tax rate is…
options: the percentage used to calculate the tax
the name of the tax office
items.why: Tax rate = alíquota: a porcentagem aplicada para calcular o imposto.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "This product has an ___, so you do not pay tax on it."
items.why: Exemption = isenção: quando algo não é taxado.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "You can ___ this cost before the tax is calculated."
items.why: To subtract = subtrair: você tira o valor antes do cálculo (é a ideia de deduction).

items.q: "The government's revenue comes mostly from taxes." Revenue here is…
items.why: Revenue = receita: o dinheiro que o governo arrecada.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please fill out the tax form." To fill out means to…
options: write your answers in a form
items.why: Fill out = preencher (um formulário).

items.q: "The manager still has to sign off on the report." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "Let's go over the numbers again." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, repassar.

items.q: "Do these numbers add up?" To add up means to…
options: make sense when you total them
items.why: Add up = somar corretamente / fazer sentido no total.

items.q: "I need to work out the tax on this amount." To work out means to…
items.why: Work out = calcular, chegar ao resultado.
